gravity.full writes the meeting channel as six factors multiplied - what one meeting is worth to a path, how much of the time the two are OPPOSED, the charges each pulse lets go on both sides, the two masses, and the meetings summed along the line. Exactly one of those asks about the SIGNS the bodies are carrying, and it is the second: the rest are counts of the tiling, masses, and a distance, and not one of them moves when a body is biased. So the biased and unbiased channels differ by that factor alone and everything else cancels out of the ratio

ANNIHILATION leaves nothing exactly when the pair is opposite - enumerated over a real facing pair, - with -: both still there; - with +: nothing left; + with -: nothing left; + with +: both still there - so how often two bodies meet opposed is how often one offers a + while the other offers a -, either way round. NOTE WHAT IS NOT ASSUMED: not that the rule destroys the opposite pairs, which was enumerated; and not that the two draws are independent, which is what drawing them from two bodies makes true

THERE IS NOTHING IN IT FOR A BIAS TO ACT ON, so it is the same for both signs of charge and cannot be screened by either. That is the part of this law that is gravity, and it is why a charged thing falls like an uncharged one even where the other channel is pulling it about
and a pair that meets opposed that fraction as often feels that fraction of the meeting channel. This line says nothing except what a ratio is
F_{q} is not a primitive of this theory - it is F_{meet}·g_{q}, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out

gravity.full writes the meeting channel as six factors multiplied - what one meeting is worth to a path, how much of the time the two are OPPOSED, the charges each pulse lets go on both sides, the two masses, and the meetings summed along the line. Exactly one of those asks about the SIGNS the bodies are carrying, and it is the second: the rest are counts of the tiling, masses, and a distance, and not one of them moves when a body is biased. So the biased and unbiased channels differ by that factor alone and everything else cancels out of the ratio

And the 1254 meetings actually run at the corners and the middle agree with it to 0.0440 against a sampling error of 0.0316. NOTE WHAT IS NOT ASSUMED: not that the rule destroys the opposite pairs, which was enumerated; and not that the two draws are independent, which is what drawing them from two bodies makes true

F_{meet}.says: the same channel for UNBIASED matter - gravity.full's meeting term, cited and not rebuilt here

F_{vac}.says: the other channel: what arrives because a body's cells are not neutral and the expansion did not happen there. It needs neither body to emit anything, so a bias has nothing to act on and it is the same for both signs

g_{q}.says: how much of that pull a biased pair actually gets

opposed.says: how much of the time a ray from one body meets an opposite ray from the other

share.says: the same fraction for unbiased matter, which is the half already sitting in the constant

annihilating.says: how many of the states a facing pair can be in are ones the rule leaves nothing of

cases.says: how many states a facing pair can be in at all - four, where the rays carry a sign

P_{a}.says: one body's bias - a fraction (1 + P)/2 of what it emits is positive
